text:
deploy-bot: Starting deployment for release/2026-03-22 to prod at 10:00 UTC. Canary plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100%. Model pinned: model-redwood/gptx-v1.3.2-quant. Change window 10:00-12:00 UTC. Deploy id=20260322-42. @alex pls confirm release notes + comms.

alex: ACK. Can we add explicit rollback criteria? Propose: error rate > 1% OR p95 latency > 1200ms sustained over 5m -> automatic rollback. Also note clients that pin to v1.3.1 should be documented.

jamie: +1. Health checks: 200 OK on /v1/health and <2% 5xx. I'll watch metrics and trigger rollback if thresholds hit. On-call? @sara will cover.

sara: I'm on-call 09:00-13:00 UTC, i'll own incident comms. If we rollback, I'll post to #incidents and DM priority customers.

priya: Drafting release notes now. Working copy: 
```
- Improved KV cache efficiency -> ~18% lower token cost.
- Model v1.3.2 (quantized): ~2x throughput on p4d, small QA-validated accuracy delta.
- Canary rollout with automatic rollback thresholds and dedicated fallback routing.
```
Need a short internal blurb for eng/support channels.

leo: I'll draft the internal announcement. Suggestion: 
"Deploying model v1.3.2-quant tomorrow 10:00 UTC. Canary rollout at 5/25/100%. Expect lower cost and improved latency. We'll post progress in this thread. Contact @sara for incidents."

alex: Add migration note for teams: "Clients pinned to v1.3.1 will be automatically routed to v1.3.2 unless they explicitly set pin=1.3.1. Recommend pinning for reproducibility."

jamie: Quick rollback runbook snippet to include in notes: 
```
# rollback quick
./deploy rollback --env=prod --to=release-20260321
# verify
curl -s -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" https://api.redwood.example/v1/health | jq .
```

deploy-bot: Canary started: 5% traffic -> canary group A. Logs: deployment id 20260322-42. Progress updates will follow here.

sara: thumbs up. priya, can you finish notes by EOD PST? We'll send the internal announcement at 09:30 UTC tomorrow.

priya: on it, final copy in 30m.

alex: One more ask — confirm dedicated capacity fallback is configured: route X% to dedicated pool if latency spikes. @jamie?

jamie: Confirmed. Fallback policy set: on latency breach, route 30% of traffic to dedicated pool for 15m, then reassess.

leo: Posting schedule: internal eng announcement at 09:30 UTC, customer-facing status update at ~10:15 after 25% step clears.

sara: Rollback policy: automatic during canary; manual rollback allowed up to 1 hour post full rollout. Agreed?

alex: Agreed.

priya: Final internal blurb (draft):
"Tomorrow 10:00 UTC we will roll out model v1.3.2-quant. Canary sequence: 5% -> 25% -> 100%. Expect ~18% lower token cost and improved p95. We'll monitor real-time and have automatic rollback criteria in place. Contact @sara for any issues"

deploy-bot: Update: canary advanced to 25% (no anomalies in first 12m).

leo: Thanks everyone — I'll queue the announcement and wait for priya's final copy.

priya: Pasted final release notes below, please review quickly: 
- KV cache improvements, unit cost -18%.
- model-redwood/gptx-v1.3.2-quant: quantized weights, throughput +2x on p4d, verified on eval set.
- Rollout: 5/25/100% canary with automatic rollback (error rate >1% or p95 >1200ms).
- Fallback: route 30% to dedicated pool on sustained latency breaches.

alex: LGTM. Ready to send.

deploy-bot: Deployment id=20260322-42 progressing. Will post final success/rollback here.
